purpose: Logical official JCB repository families and discovery entry points. This is neither an exhaustive network endpoint list nor a JCB runtime configuration.
discovery_policy: Enumerate all live targets; inspect each target's advertised exact URLs. Target hints below aid recognition and do not whitelist or exhaust future models. Preserve the actual source branch/revision and consuming JCB repository order.

families.role: Shared PHP class foundation; the referenced registry also lists Gitea, OpenAI, Search, phpseclib, PSR and Minify specialist sources.
Version-aware Joomla class references; inspect the Joomla Power contract rather than assuming the Super Power format.
Official core metadata and defaults for concrete Fields.
Reusable view source and its classifications.
Default reusable component, module, plugin, view, Field, query, layout, code and relationship graph. Other package collections remain independent sources, not aliases of this default.
JCB repository setup catalogue. Resolve the actual repository URL and its format from discovery and that repository's documentation; target name need not equal repository name.

additional_sources.role: Separate package collection; require actual access and preserve its own source identity. Never substitute the default packages mirror.
Standalone reference blueprint; separate from the default package catalogue.
